[[image:large altara map.png|thumb|right|Malvide Narrows in central Altara]]
The '''Malvide Narrows''', in [[Altara]], is the narrowest point of the [[Molvaine Gap]], a pass through the [[Damona Mountains]]. The [[Great North Road]], also known regionally as the Lugard Road, runs through the Malvide Narrows.
==Battles==
In the spring of {{ne|1000}} [[Mat Cauthon]] [[Battle of the Malvide Narrows|fought]] and defeated a [[Seanchan]] army in the vicinity of the Malvide Narrows.
